zh.title: 审批已经用掉，外部效果却未必交付
zh.summary: 来源代码派生的隔离数据库探针每轮只放行一个审批消费者；故意省略后续效果后，重试仍被拒绝。这支持单次消费边界，不能证明外部交付或崩溃恢复。

en.title: A Useful Scientific Fallback Still Changes the Task
en.summary: Archived inputs distinguish a two-state request from a four-state fallback. Input conformance preserves method identity, while chemical validity and change authorization need separate evidence.
